title: Section specialization for the supported diagonal insertion
statement:
Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell and a scheme S where ell is invertible. Let p be a normalized projective-line tower Presentation, d its Maps and h its EtaleOriginComparisonsWithLine, as in [lem-sp-tower-p1-etale-origin-comparisons]. All words below are the actual derived tensor, projection and mate words of [def-sp-tower-p1-triangle-words]. The precise assertion is:
theorem towerP1DiagonalProjectionFactor (p : Presentation l E S hS) (d : Maps l E p)
    (h : EtaleOriginComparisonsWithLine l E p d) (a : Bool)
    (M : C l E p.classes.base (ProjectiveLine S)) :
    diagonalInsertion l E h a M =
      diagonalTensorFactor l E p a M.obj ≫
        outsideProjection l E p a M.obj ((line l E p.classes.chernW)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)

proof.text: apply ringedProjectionTensorComposition in the actual inverse-system ringed topoi, with i=Delta, p=p_i and V=A_P in its section specialization. Normalize the pullback of p_i along Delta by diagonalPull and the identity pullback in Presentation; Operations.comp_termwise fixes this normalization before localization. The conjugate right comparison is the inverse of sourceUnitAt. The section identity, with these normalizations and the left and right coefficient unitors, identifies the inverse supported projection followed by push p_i with rightUnit_M inverse and identity_M tensor sourceUnitAt(A_P), followed by the outside-first projection at Delta_*A_P. Projection naturality in the arrow delta:Delta_*A_P -> T_W moves delta across that outside projection. Naturality of the recorded signed symmetry gives the same outside-first order as diagonalInsertion and outsideProjection. The result is rightUnit_M inverse followed by identity_M tensor (sourceUnitAt(A_P) then Rp_i(delta)), then outsideProjection(M,T_W), exactly diagonalTensorFactor then outsideProjection. In particular the source alpha_i is not discarded and the argument is valid for both Bool values and for the zero object, without a Tor hypothesis.
